messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "it may take up to 2 weeks before your cholesterol levels improve"
set: ["it may take up to 2 weeks before your cholesterol levels improve", "it may take up to 2 weeks before symptoms improve", "symptoms may not improve for up to 2 to 6 weeks", "your symptoms may not improve for up to several weeks", "symptoms may not improve for up to 4 weeks", "up to 2 to 3 weeks", "may take 1 to 4 days before symptoms improve", "may take up to 8 weeks of using this medicine before ulcer heals", "it may take 4 weeks or longer before you feel the full benefit", "may take several weeks before you notice a difference", "2 to 3 weeks", "it may take 4 to 6 weeks to get the full benefit of a dose", "take 2 hours before or after sucralfate", "take for 4 to 6 weeks before feeling full effects", "1 to 2 weeks for improvement in sleep, appetite, or energy levels", "requires 1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for full effect to build up"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
